head: claude/wo-20260908-rearm-56-naked-tlt
title: work: defer the TLT 56-share re-arm — the only Alpaca path cancels the leg it must preserve
body:
## Summary

`WO-20260908-RE-ARM-PROTECTION-FOR-THE-56-NAKED`. **The re-arm was NOT performed, and nothing was placed, cancelled, amended or closed on any account.** The mandate's constraint 3 governs the outcome: the only code path that places an Alpaca protective leg is symbol-scoped and would delete the very leg constraint 2 requires to survive. This PR is documentation only — the finding, its blast radius, and two backlog rows.

Deferring is one of the two completions the work order's own `done_condition` admits.

### What was measured

`/api/diag/alpaca_open_orders`, per-account `read_state: orders_read` — the per-account field, never the summary line (MI-177) — at **2026-09-08T04:47:34Z** (fleet-wide, 11 accounts) and again at **04:50:13Z**. Identical both times.

| | |
|---|---|
| `alpaca_portfolio` TLT position | short **72** @ 82.309028 |
| resting protective legs on TLT | **one** OCO pair, qty **16**: buy limit 74.67 (`292b3240`, submitted 08-31T13:36:40Z) + buy stop **82.33** (`742c3729`, submitted **09-04T17:35:55Z**) |
| journal | trade **5266** (`tlt_pullback_1d`, short 16, `stop_loss` **84.61875**) + trade **5414** (`tlt_pullback_1h`, short 56, `stop_loss` **82.32875**); 16 + 56 = 72, matching the venue exactly |
| uncovered | **56 of 72 shares**, since ~2026-09-03 — the briefed condition, independently confirmed |
| `alpaca_live` | **flat** (0 positions, 0 orders, `read_state: orders_read`). Out of scope; untouched. |

### Why it cannot be done safely today (the blast radius, from code at `ed37f5ba`)

`AlpacaClient.place_protective` (`alpaca_client.py:1361`) is the **only** path in the repo that places an Alpaca protective leg, and its **only** caller is `order_monitor._attempt_naked_autoprotect`. At line 1405 it calls `_cancel_open_orders_for_symbol(sym)` **unconditionally** → `_open_orders_for_symbol` → `DELETE /v2/orders/{id}` for **every** open order on the symbol, parents and nested legs — i.e. both of trade 5266's legs.

The caller passes `oca_key` specifically to scope that cancel, under a comment naming `BL-20260814`. `IBClient.place_protective` honours it; **the Alpaca one reads only `symbol`/`direction`/`qty`/`sl`/`tp` and drops it silently.** The mitigation *looks* applied at the call site.

No other route reaches the goal, and each was checked rather than assumed:

- `modify_protective` — PATCHes existing legs; cannot create coverage for uncovered shares.
- `close(symbol)` — whole-symbol, no qty parameter (MI-173); also not the approved action.
- `place()` — a bracket **MARKET entry**; on a short a buy would *reduce* the position.
- `system-actions` allowlist — has `flatten-alpaca-position`, `attach-ib-target`, `cancel-ib-order`; **no Alpaca protective-attach action**, so there is no sanctioned wire to invoke a repair from a session either.

### ⚠️ The work order's premise is corrected, and this is the more valuable finding

The brief says the resting 16-share leg is trade 5266's *and matches the journal*, echoing `BL-20260820-OVERCOVER-REMEDIATION-CANCELLED-THE-JOURNAL-MATCHING-LEG`. The leg **is** 5266's (qty 16; limit 74.67 = 5266's `take_profit_1` 74.670375) — but it **does not match 5266's journal**. 5266 declares 84.61875; the leg rests at **82.33**, which is trade **5414's** declared 82.32875 to 2dp.

Corroborated two ways: the stop leg's `submitted_at` postdates its own parent's by four days and postdates 5414's open (the signature of a PATCH leg-replace, which re-submits the leg while the parent keeps its timestamp); and the un-patched `alpaca_paper` mirror carries TLT stop **84.62**, so 84.62 is what `tlt_pullback_1d` declares.

Mechanism: `execute.modify_open_order`'s IB branch passes `oca_key`; its **Alpaca** branch calls `modify_protective(symbol, sl, tp)` with no trade scope, and that method PATCHes **every** stop leg on the symbol. Trade 5414's routine trailing amend rewrote trade 5266's protective level.

### Why it has stayed naked

`order_monitor._check_broker_naked_equity_positions` grades stop coverage as a **symbol-wide boolean** — `if state.get("stop"): continue` — so 5266's resting leg makes the whole TLT symbol read "stop armed" and 5414 is skipped every pass. **It will never self-heal.** That belongs to `WO-20260908-ALPACA-PROTECTIVE-COVERAGE-IS-GRADED-BY-SIDE` and is deliberately not duplicated here.

## Architecture impact

- [x] **Not applicable** — documentation only. No schema, boundary, pipeline stage, API, contract or config shape is touched.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` → **PASS 55 · FAIL 0 · SKIP 35**
- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py --base origin/main` → `OK — state=declared_needs_approval`
- [x] Two guards initially failed on my own diff and both were fair — a greppable backlog id wrapped across a line, and `$1,289.73` quoted without its population. Both fixed, both re-verified.
- [x] `trainer-capture-watch-guard` / `operator-owed-guard` failed **only because `pytest` was absent from this container**; installed it and all **78 tests pass**. This diff contains no Python.
- [x] Live state re-read after the work: unchanged from before it (04:47:34Z vs 04:50:13Z).
- [ ] CI green

## Filed for follow-ups

- `BL-20260908-ALPACA-PLACE-PROTECTIVE-IGNORES-OCA-KEY-SO-EVERY-RE-ARM-IS-SYMBOL-WIDE` (critical) — the blocker.
- `BL-20260908-ALPACA-TRAILING-AMEND-PATCHED-A-SIBLING-TRADES-STOP-TO-THE-WRONG-DECLARED-LEVEL` (high) — the premise correction.

Both filed with `similar_ok` as **recurrences** of `BL-20260825-THE-TRAILING-AMEND-NEVER-PASSES-OCA-KEY-SO-IT-STILL-CANCELS-SYMBOL-WIDE`, on a venue where the scoping parameter does not exist to be passed — so fixing call sites cannot reach it.

The work object is now `lifecycle: waiting` with a **true** typed edge: `blocked_on: [{kind: capability, ref: BL-20260908-ALPACA-PLACE-PROTECTIVE-IGNORES-OCA-KEY-…}]`, `blocked_on_basis: ASSESSED`.

### What is NOT established — stated rather than filled in

- We did **not** read the audit trail to confirm which amend wrote 82.33 at 09-04T17:35:55Z. The price and timestamps make trade 5414 the strong reading; it is recorded as a **reconstruction**, not an observation.
- We did **not** measure quantity-coverage across the other Alpaca accounts — that is the sibling WO's job.
- No `▶️ START` was posted to coordination board #6927: it is at GitHub's hard 2500-comment cap and writes 403. Known and parked as **MI-182**; not retried.

### What the operator is being asked to approve

Closing this needs a **new qty-scoped Alpaca protective-attach capability** — a Tier-2 order-path change. The 2026-09-08 approval was to *re-arm rather than monitor or flatten*; that is not approval to ship an order path. Hence `landing: hold`, `hold_reason: tier_2_3_needs_approval`.

⚠️ **Do not retry the re-arm through the existing path.** The blast radius above is measured, not suspected.
